summary: Malheur NF ground site, Thorn Creek Butte, Grant County, OR; L-4 cab dated 1933 or 1934, removed or destroyed in 1958; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com say the cab was removed in 1958; a 1958 USGS recovery note says the tower was destroyed. No source describes the site now.

events.note: Developed in 1933 with an L-4 cab, per the register and firelookout.com
Forest Service survey description (1933) places the survey point on a truck road
Oregon Lookouts page dates an L-4 ground house to 1934; conflicts with the 1933 date
Malheur National Forest asked to build a garage and storage building at the lookout (memo of May 10, 1938); approved
Camp Canyon Creek constructing a garage at the Thorn Butte lookout (John Day Valley Ranger report, August 2, 1940)
Register and firelookout.com: cab removed in 1958 after several years of abandonment
USGS recovery note (1958): lookout tower destroyed and the USFS survey mark not recovered; conflicts with 'removed'
Registered July 18, 2011 as FFLOS US 1094, OR 451

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com say 1933; the Oregon Lookouts page says an L-4 ground house was built in 1934. The story gives both dates and does not choose one.
The register and firelookout.com say the cab was removed in 1958; a 1958 USGS recovery note on the Oregon Lookouts page says the tower was destroyed. The story reports both wordings.

notes_for_editor: Gone status is supported. Sources disagree on the build year (1933 vs 1934) and on removed vs destroyed in 1958; the story gives both. Staffing and access are not in any source, so they are left out of facts. No source describes the site now. Search results included an Idaho lookout also named Thorn Creek Butte; it was not used. Used 1 fallback web search and 3 page reads of the cached pages plus the Oregon Lookouts page.
